The specification's read/inferred/unknown markers and its closing coverage statement stand in for the absent second reader and are explicitly weaker than one.

rights.basis: MIT, read at the source. Reading and reimplementing are permitted. The counterpart must not copy source text; the specification and the implementation carry no upstream identifier, which checks/verify-counterparts.sh identifier rules were run over.
MIT imposes no behavioural restriction and the inventory records sourceUse as permitted for this entry.
MIT does not grant trademark rights, so the project's own name and its content identifiers remain unresolved. The specification and counterpart therefore name nothing after the original.
No asset was fetched or read; the tool's only persistent surface is an item registration and the rest is client drawing.
No branding material was fetched or read.
